headline: in blue climbs from 742nd to 31st on ARC-AGI-3

sections.text: in blue gained 7.04 to reach 36.87 on the ARC-AGI-3 public board, moving from 742nd to 31st in the past day.
That climb puts in blue among the board's top 31 teams. Public standings remain provisional.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
